ideas.pitch: A Python and constraint-solver tool to compute optimal center of gravity, wing area, and golf ball payload distribution for fixed-wing RC aircraft.
ideas.problem_statement: Boeing–IIT National Aeromodelling Competition 2025–26: design and operate an RC fixed-wing aircraft capable of maximum payload relative to its weight and accurate drop delivery.
ideas.title: AeroPayload Optimizer & CG Calculator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact heavy-lift aero math required for the Boeing-IIT competition, aligning directly with the core scoring metric of payload-to-aircraft weight ratio.

ideas.pitch: An Arduino-based servo release mechanism with automated altitude and distance triggers using onboard IMU and ultrasonic sensors to accurately drop golf ball payloads.
ideas.problem_statement: Boeing–IIT National Aeromodelling Competition 2025–26: deliver the payload accurately to a designated drop zone.
ideas.title: DropZone Precision Release Actuator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an unusual physical build and hardware demonstration that stands out to judges evaluating the drop accuracy round.

ideas.pitch: A real-time telemetry dashboard transmitting flight velocity, battery voltage, and payload compartment status from the RC aircraft to a ground station via ESP32 Wi-Fi/Radio.
ideas.problem_statement: Boeing–IIT National Aeromodelling Competition 2025–26: technical details of the aircraft, including dimensions, wing area, and velocity, plus safe flight demonstration.
ideas.title: AeroTelemetry Live Link
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides hard quantitative telemetry data during the flight rounds, impressing judges with professional-grade monitoring systems.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight finite element method (FEM) script to simulate lift stress and structural weak points on balsa wood or foam wing spars before physical construction.
ideas.problem_statement: Boeing–IIT National Aeromodelling Competition 2025–26: design abstract submission documenting construction and technical details addressing the problem statement.
ideas.title: Airframe Finite Element Stress Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous engineering simulation, directly aiding the Stage 1 Design Abstract screening process by providing quantified structural safety proofs.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computer vision system mounted near the payload bay to detect and log the exact instant the aircraft passes over the target drop zone circle.
ideas.problem_statement: Boeing–IIT National Aeromodelling Competition 2025–26: deliver it accurately to a designated drop zone.
ideas.title: AeroVision Drop Zone Target Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings advanced computer vision and hardware integration into an aeromodelling context, matching the pattern of genuinely hard engineering.
